mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.5 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader demand weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index base 2017=100), indicating a contraction in manufacturing output, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to rising recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3 percentage points from the prior month indicates accelerating inflation, triggering a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy cycle amid rising inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increase, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, indicating weakening consumer demand, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
